entries.title: Fixed Oval Toothed Cup And Separated Ring Display
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed oval-cup and separated-ring mechanism-style display. A deep thin-wall cup changes continuously from a circular annular rear to an oval mouth with integral blunt outer teeth; its real deep cavity and rear shaft bore are not a solid oval cylinder. A separate complete internally toothed circular annulus stands ahead on two full roots. A smaller complete bored elliptical insert is independently supported further forward, leaving explicit axial separation between all three principal pieces. Whole front and rear shafts, bored bearings, pedestals and one shared ground bed make a single supported exhibit. Unlike the old planetary layout there is no sun/planet set or rear multi-pin carrier; unlike the conical clutch the main cavity is non-axisymmetric with a toothed rim, not a mating pair of cones and a shift fork. No old gear or bearing mesh imported. Three opaque PBR appearances, metres Z-up and full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One complete model zero scenes. Fixed illustrative separated shapes only, not a working strain-wave reducer or engineering design. No elastic deformation, tooth conjugacy, meshing, motion solution, speed ratio, torque, running fit, bearing performance, lubrication, manufacturing, assembly instructions or safety capability. No rigging animation interaction made.

entries.title: Fixed Shared Reservoir and Cross Linked Open Cups
entries.description: One newly authored complete static cross-linked vessel apparatus appearance. Two whole rear posts and finite brackets support one continuous open upper reservoir with two true through floor apertures and complete downward mouths. Two separate open thick rings lie below those mouths and above two full deep empty lower cups on independent short pedestals. Each ring has one continuous bent rigid rod crossing to the opposite lower cup at a different depth, leaving the crossing genuinely separated. The common plinth, grounded frame, real upper passages, ring bores, lower cup cavities and two crossed complete connection paths define the one whole apparatus. Unlike the old sector-disc machine there are no axle discs, belt, collecting canister lids or spark terminals; unlike the water-clock there is no float, index rod, guide or scale and no single cutaway receiver. All visible coordinates newly authored, generic mesh/export helpers only; no old asset meshes or parts imported. One model zero scenes. Four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres native Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. Kelvin-dropper-inspired dry artistic exterior only, not a working experiment: no liquid, droplets, charge, electricity, voltage, insulation, induction, cross-connection circuit validity, flow, measurement, physics demonstration, teaching result, manufacture, loading or safety claim. No rigging animation or interaction.

entries.title: Whole Empty Kick Wheel Chest and Reclaim Bay
entries.description: One static traditional pottery-equipment preparation bay, one scene and zero new independent models. Three complete qualified originals preserve all original raw geometry buffers, normals, internal hierarchy, opaque PBR and unit scale. The entire open-frame kick-wheel station occupies the front-left, keeping its integral rear seat, high disk, vertical shaft and exposed lower flywheel intact and empty. A complete twin-track clay chest stands separately at front-right in its original partly retracted fixed-cover pose. The entire unequal-depth stepped-weir basin stands along the rear with both original side mouths, partition saddle and complete leg frame untouched. An open intervening floor band separates these three independent equipment positions; no hose, clay, water, pottery, tools or person joins them. Unlike the old tabletop turntable with blank and trimming kit, no vessel or tool is mounted on this wheel; unlike the shelf-and-jar storage exhibit, there is no shelf, jar or finished pottery display. This is a complete empty preparation grouping, not a functioning reclaim or throwing process and not three newly counted models. Only whole translations and a finite scene-only floor are new. No spinning, kicking, sliding travel, drainage, material suitability, storage preservation, ergonomic operation, human access, loading, installation or workshop safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Whole Raised Mitre Head and Parked Support Bay
entries.description: One empty woodworking crosscut-equipment preparation bay, one scene zero new independent models. One whole fixed raised-head mitre-saw exterior rests on a complete original open worktable, retaining its entire split round table, wide base, four original support pads, pivot head, toothless disc and guard, grip and front handle. A complete deployed single-roller stand occupies a separate floor station to the left, and a complete canister vacuum with its original continuous hose, wand and floor nozzle occupies a separate station at the right. No workpiece bridges these units; the roller remains its original height, explicitly not matched to the saw platform, and the vacuum hose is not connected to the saw. The whole saw pad soles are supported by the actual table top after a small whole-unit rear/front offset, without scaling or trimming any old part. All original unit-scale GLB buffers, normals, hierarchy and opaque PBR remain unchanged. Only the finite floor is new scene-only geometry. Unlike the old hand-saw-on-sawhorses corner and the perpendicular jointer/planer surface workarea, this shows a complete raised circular-head station with separately parked support and cleanup equipment. No cutting, feed trajectory, extraction, drive, sharp edge, electrical operation, load, ergonomic suitability, installation or workshop safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.
